items.text: We are thrilled to announce a major update for the Mate’Morphosis demo, incorporating new features and polish! This patch delivers a handful of fixes, quality-of-life improvements, and several new features based on the valuable feedback we've received. It has been an incredible journey shaping this demo, refining the game's core mechanics, and designing exciting new levels for all of you.
This release represents the final step before we transition to the Release Candidate phase. We can't wait to share the complete, full-release experience with you very soon!

notes.title: ✨ What's New in This Demo Update

items.text: Piece Variant Customization: Personalize your experience by customizing piece appearances.♟️
Board Color Options: Change the aesthetic with various board color choices. 🏁
Multi-Language Localization: The demo now supports multiple languages. 🏳️

notes.title: 🚀 Coming Soon in the Full Release

items.text: Massive Content Drop: Prepare for LOTS OF NEW LEVELS! ⛳️
Input Flexibility: Full support for Touch, Keyboard, and Controller inputs. 🎮
Future Roadmap: Details on the first major update following the official launch. 🕵️

notes.title: ⚠️ Known Issues to Be Aware Of

items.text: All on-screen items occasionally become movable under unknown conditions (This issue is still being investigated). 😫
The player sprite may sometimes incorrectly transform into a crown. 👑
Hostile (red) pieces exhibit buggy behavior when chained together. 🔴

If you encounter any of these or other bugs while playing, please report them in the comments below or via our Community Hub page. Your feedback is crucial in helping us make Mate’Morphosis the best possible experience for the full launch!
Stay tuned—the full release is sooner than ever!
